items.name: Priyanka Sahoo
items.text: Best salon near Trident College area. Got a keratin treatment done and the result was absolutely smooth. Staff is well-trained and the pricing is very reasonable for the quality you get.

items.name: Rajesh Mohanty
items.text: Been coming here for over 3 years for haircuts. The stylists understand exactly what you want without much explanation. Clean setup, no unnecessary upselling, and always on time.

items.name: Smita Panda
items.text: Got my bridal makeup done at Vedas for my reception. The HD finish was flawless and lasted through the entire evening. Highly recommend their bridal packages.

items.name: Aditya Mishra
items.text: Great place for men's grooming. Beard sculpting was done with precision. The hot towel finish is a nice touch. Pocket-friendly and professional service every time.

items.name: Nibedita Das
items.text: The hair colour came out exactly how I wanted. They used ammonia-free products which made a huge difference. The salon interior is clean and well-maintained. Will definitely visit again.

items.name: Bikash Jena
items.text: Visited for a hair spa and head massage after a recommendation from a friend. Very relaxing experience, and the staff was courteous throughout. Good value near Infocity area.
